item.title: How Does a Recommendation Model Benefit from Reasoning?
item.author: mycaptainmy@gmail.com (Yuan Meng)
item.description: One night, I got a baffling message from a friend: “Don’t go to that restaurant!” Turns out she’d tried a new place from a Xiaohongshu post I had forwarded to her, and it was terrible. “Oh, I wasn’t recommending it,” I explained. “Then what was your intent?” she asked. “I was scrolling my feed before bed and forwarded the first new place I saw. There was no thought behind it.” “Well,” she joked, “I guess I was a shitty reasoning model that made up all that intent.”
